settings.heading: A getaway for everybody.
settings.lede: We began with one wish: body care that feels like the first day of a holiday, minus the long ingredient list.
settings.image_alt: Two friends sharing a towel on a sunlit beach
Raw coconut oil in a glass jar
settings.heading: A list of what stays out.
settings.text: Our standard bars more than two hundred substances, including phthalates, sulfates and parabens. What remains is plant-based, vegan and never tested on animals.

settings.heading: Textures you want to touch.
settings.text: We build butters, mists and gels around actives like hyaluronic acid, gentle acids and peptides, then tune the scent so products can be layered together.

settings.image_alt: Recyclable bottles lined up on a beach table
settings.heading: Bottles that can come back around.
settings.text: In 2021 we moved the whole line into recyclable packaging, with post-consumer recycled plastic wherever the formula allows.

settings.heading: A few numbers we are proud of.
settings.note: Figures from our most recent packaging and impact review.

settings.quote: “We wanted a shelf that feels like a trip to the tropics but works as hard as anything in the medicine cabinet.”
settings.note: The two cofounders still test new scents and textures themselves before anything is approved.
